subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.

I hope you __have enjoying yourselves__ at the party tonight!
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e., "enjoy yourselves".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence "I hope you have enjoying yourselves at the party tonight!" is incorrect due to the grammatical structure.
 
• The phrase should be in the present simple tense, which is more appropriate for expressing a hope or wish.
 
• Therefore, the correct substitution is "enjoy yourselves".

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *I hope you enjoy yourselves at the party tonight!*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• "enjoys yourselves" is incorrect as "enjoys" is singular and doesn't agree with "yourselves".
 
• "are enjoying themselves" changes the subject to "themselves" instead of "you".
 
• "will be enjoy himself" has a grammatical error and also changes the subject to "himself".
 
 
 
• Using the correct verb form ensures clarity and proper sentence structure.
